interventions.detail: Used a uv venv with Python 3.12 instead of the README's conda env (conda not available)
Installed CPU-only torch from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu before pip install -e .
apt install libmagic1 for the python-magic dependency
Set HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 because the unauthenticated Xet download of gpt2 returned 404; pre-downloaded gpt2 into HF_HOME

huggingface.Pipeline._call_model: pass max_new_tokens + handle_long_generation='hole' (+return_full_text=False when deprefixing) so the 1057-token DAN prompt fits gpt2's 1024 context instead of erroring with None outputs
